meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会新增一条 Signal 通道:通过 signal-cli 设备链接,把你手机上已有的 Signal 作为副设备接入,助手用该手机号收发消息,不需要新号码,也不用机器人 API。
howto.when: 当你希望助手用 Signal 收发私聊或群聊消息、要接入 Signal 通道时;或在 /setup 流程中加这个渠道时。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 接到 NanoClaw 上
say.note: 走设备链接扫码流程,用你手机上的号

say.text: 重新跑一遍 Signal 的设备链接
say.note: 链接约 3 分钟过期,重跑拿新码

say.text: 用 /manage-channels 把这条 Signal 会话接上
say.note: 需先发一条消息生成会话记录

howto.what_en: Adds a native Signal channel. NanoClaw links to Signal as a secondary device via signal-cli, so your assistant sends and receives as the number on the phone that scans the QR — no new number, no bot API.
howto.when_en: Use when you want your assistant to send and receive Signal DMs or groups, or while running /setup to add this channel.

say_en.note: Runs the device-link QR flow on your phone number
Send a message first to create the row
